results.evidence: tests/test_report_inbound_other.py inserts a lead with channel 'fax' and segment 'industrial' by raw SQL INSERT (_insert_raw), then runs the report. It asserts the inquiry total is 3, the channel counts sum to 3 and the segment counts sum to 3. It also asserts the unknown value is counted under report.OTHER ('other'): channels == {form:1, phone:1, other:1}, segments == {commercial:1, residential:1, unknown:0, other:1}. cottonwood/report.py adds _count(), which puts any value outside inbound.CHANNELS or inbound.SEGMENTS under OTHER. Both tests in the file pass (2 passed).

_count in report.py adds the OTHER key only when an unknown value lands in it, so a report with only known channels and segments has no 'other' line. test_no_other_line_when_every_value_is_known asserts this and passes. I ran all four commands: uv run pytest gave 1366 passed, ruff check gave 'All checks passed!', mypy gave 'no issues found in 198 source files', and ruff format --check gave '408 files already formatted'.
